gloss: departure; setting out; new start in life

definitions.gloss: departure; setting out on a journey
definitions.explanation: Leaving one's home or familiar place to embark on a journey. Somewhat literary.

definitions.gloss: new start in life; new beginning; fresh start
definitions.explanation: Beginning a new chapter in life, such as starting a career, getting married, or entering a new phase. Often used at graduation ceremonies and celebrations.

examples.japanese: {旅|たび}の{門出|かどで}を{祝|いわ}った。
examples.english: We celebrated the departure on the journey.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{中|なか}、{門出|かどで}の{日|ひ}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: We greeted the day of departure in the rain.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}に{見送|みおく}られながら、{新|あたら}しい{土地|とち}への{門出|かどで}の{第一歩|だいいっぽ}を{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Seen off by my family, I took the first step on my departure to a new place.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{門出|かどで}を{祝|いわ}う。
{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}は{人生|じんせい}の{門出|かどで}の{日|ひ}だ。
examples.english: Graduation day is a day of new beginnings in life.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{新|あたら}しい{門出|かどで}を{心|こころ}から{祝福|しゅくふく}いたします。
examples.english: I sincerely congratulate you both on your new beginning together.

notes:
USAGE:
{門出|かどで} literally means "going out through the gate." It has a celebratory, auspicious tone and is commonly used at ceremonies and formal occasions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門出|かどで}を{祝|いわ}う (to celebrate a new start)
- {門出|かどで}の{日|ひ} (the day of departure/new beginning)
- {新|あたら}しい{門出|かどで} (a new start)
- {人生|じんせい}の{門出|かどで} (a new chapter in life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {門出|かどで}: departure, new start (ceremonial, auspicious tone)
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}: departure (practical, everyday)
- {旅立|たびだ}ち: setting off on a journey (poetic, emotional)
